blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Bureau of Customs (BOC) on Tuesday filed criminal complaints against some of its officers and personnel as well as a licensed customs broker over the illegal shipment of thousands of sacks of onions and carrots misdeclared as chicken lollipops BOC Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno led the filing of six criminal complaints before the Department of Justice against Berches Consumer Goods Trading, the importer which is also a licensed customs broker, and customs officials and staff for the illegal shipment of 15,029 sacks of fresh white onions and 2,164 boxes of fresh carrots.
